name: 8-bit
description: This project is a unique educational technology platform that uses the nostalgic aesthetic of an 8-bit web game to guide students through the complex process of college program matching and career exploration. By integrating a modern AI recommendation engine with a fun, gamified user experience, we aim to make informed decision-making accessible, engaging, and personal.

scripts.ship: npm run build && npx gh-pages -d dist -b testing
